text.p: Tropical cyclone 07b is mostly dissipated at this time. The threat of further flooding is greatly reduced. This system came from the Bay of Bengal and made landfall over eastern India, with Andhra Pradesh particularly hard-hit. The full extend of the damage will probably not be known for another day or two. We expect that the damage due to flooding, mudslides, a storm surge and very strong winds will be extemely high...especially in Andhra Pradesh.

Tropical Cyclone Melanie-Bellamine is a very powerful storm with 135 mph top winds. The storm threatens only shipping in the southern Indian Ocean. It is centered near 17s/77e and tracking to the south southeast. It will gradually weaken this weekend.

Tropical storm Ernie, in the South China Sea, will main affect shipping this weekend as it tracks slowly towards the northwest. It is still expected to be in the South China Sea on Sunday with top winds of 75 mph.

Typhoon Dale, with 100 mph winds, is mainly a threat to shipping well to the west of Guam at this time. This system strengthens during the weekend, becoming a supertyphoon in 48 hours with winds of 150 mph. This will then be a major threat to shipping. It should still be well east of the Philippines in 48 hours. In 72 hours it turns towards the northwest. This may mean that the Philippines would not be affected but it still bears watching since it will be a powerfull typhoon at that time.
